answer.reason: Eliashib is told of in two deeds: helping rebuild the sheep gate, and preparing a chamber in the temple for Tobiah.

clauses.english: rose up with his fellow priests and built and sanctified the sheep gate
clauses.quote: they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it

clauses.english: prepared a great chamber in the house of God for Tobiah
clauses.quote: he had prepared for him a great chamber

doubts: EZR 10:6 names Johanan son of Eliashib, which may be a different Eliashib, so it was left out.
NEH 13:28 tells of a grandson's marriage, not Eliashib's own deed, so it was left out.
NEH 12:10, 12:22-23 are genealogy and lists only, and were not used.
